analysis.rationale: Exact recovery: pipeline blur_lens:4 -> compression_jpeg:4 -> saturate_weaken_HSV:5 reproduces target bit-exactly (PSNR=inf, CI 10/10) on pair0 and on all k=3 support pairs (clean_1/degraded_1, clean_2/degraded_2). Exactness implies deterministic functions, severities and order (blur -> JPEG -> saturation, i.e. desaturation applied after JPEG storage) are all correct. Noise ruled out (noise_prior sigma=1.11<2; peeled residual std=0.0 after stripping pipeline). Global is saturate_weaken_HSV:5 (HSV variant +8.6dB over no-global; YCrCb variant 24.7dB vs 30.6dB-equivalent ordering); brightness ruled out (brighten_shift:1 dropped PSNR to 19.23). JPEG:4 preferred over jpeg:3 (29.48dB but block_boundary diff 19% vs 3% at sev4) because block_boundary is 0% FP and PSNR difference 0.18dB is noise-level; jpeg:5 27.78dB. blur_lens:4 > blur_gaussian:4 (29.02) > motion:4 (18.95), lens severity 3/5 worse. Alternatives empty: winner is bit-exact, gap to runner-up is unbounded, no training-time arbitration needed.
